scope: Existing six teams and dates only; Boston and fixtures separately. No model/holdout.

knowledge.ever_known: All acquired B-eligible injury reports and recap injury signals through decision, without retrospective C. Retain history within observed archive, never claim lifetime completeness.
knowledge.recent: Trailing 28 elapsed days for both injury reports and recap signals; separate from ever-known history.
knowledge.status: Latest B-eligible status per target game; current only if target game has not completed by decision, or date >= decision local date when completion unknown. Omission is not resolution. Expire after target game completion. Explicit Available/superseding status is recorded, not inferred from omission.
knowledge.acute: Same-event flag only when an identified future event links the original B-eligible acute disclosure. Generic rows carry prior_acute_history, not same-event disclosure. C linkage describes retrospective strata only; never eligibility/features.

segments.definition: Maximal consecutive individually injury-attributed actual applicable-team missed games, with verified roster and full page/book; conflict/unknown/noninjury/gap breaks segment. Never sum segments.
segments.continuity: Review total evidence: complete absence sequence, same anatomical condition/side, consecutive contemporaneous status records referring to same ongoing absence, no return or new trauma, and contextual recap/return/rehab evidence. Diagnosis matching alone insufficient. Explicit narrative is sufficient but not mandatory. Document supporting and contradictory assertions per reviewed segment.
segments.anchor: Preserve original registered envelope anchor. Later qualifying segment establishes severity only; ambiguous original common identity/onset remains unknown. Do not move anchor to maximize labels.

clocks: Parse explicit fixed numeric abbreviation offsets, not seasonal ZoneInfo substitution. Use scheduled UTC date to resolve local date rollover; explicit UTC suffix means UTC only in scheduled field. gameEt trailing Z is an Eastern wall-clock mislabeled as UTC and never used. Untagged clock unknown absent independent timezone evidence. Preserve raw source text/minute precision and official-book comparison; small distinct timestamp discrepancy does not itself prove parser bug.
membership: Target public dated contracts/waivers by affected-row counts. Retain ambiguous intervals and absent roster reasons; never create zero workload or injury from missing record.
selection: Rules selected for interpretability, not positivity or missingness optimization; all changed fields traced.
